annotation.authors_or_issuer: Japan (National Diet; National Public Safety Commission/Cabinet Office)
annotation.summary_en: Japan's Road Traffic Act (1960), current revision enforced July 2026. Comprehensive road traffic rules, driver licensing and penalties. Includes embodied provisions: Chapter 2-2 on remotely operated small vehicles (delivery robots) with notification duties, and Chapter 4-3 on permits for Level 4 "specific automated operation", with supervisors, accident response and permit revocation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Chapter 2-2 requires users of remotely operated small vehicles to notify the Public Safety Commission, display ID numbers, and fit emergency stop devices.
Article 75-12 requires a Public Safety Commission permit for specific automated operation (Level 4), based on an operation plan.
Specific automated operation operators must appoint supervisors, monitor remotely or ride along, and handle accidents and police instructions.
Permits can be revoked or suspended, and instructions and provisional suspension can be issued by police chiefs.
Drivers using automated driving systems must not use them outside the operating conditions and must be able to take over.
